page.overview:
Who is Doodle Wizard?

Doodle Wizard is a wizard in Ooo that only appears in the mobile game, Adventure Time Game Wizard. Not much is known about him.

Doodle Wizard has a denim cloak and a hat with a patch on it. The cloak is a light blue, while the hat is darker. He carries around a small leather bag with a golden button on it. His skin is a very light blue, lighter than that of his clothing. Doodle Wizard wears dark blue pants, and has shoes the color of his cloak. He carries around a staff, which is very similar to a pencil. One tip is black, while the other end has an eraser on it.

He can draw images and bring them to life with secret glyphs.
